mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT Workshop FROM RSWS_TempMonitor_Copy WHERE Workshop = '1#办公楼'
SELECT TOP 100 * FROM RSWS_TempMonitor_Copy WHERE Workshop = '1#办公楼' ORDER BY UpdateTime DESC

WITH LatestData AS ( SELECT DeviceID, Name, ElectricEnergy, UpdateTime, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY DeviceID, Name ORDER BY UpdateTime DESC) as rn FROM RSWS_TempMonitor_Copy WHERE Workshop = '1#办公楼' AND ElectricEnergy IS NOT NULL AND UpdateTime >= DATEADD(DAY, -1, GETDATE()) ), TodayData AS ( SELECT SUM(ElectricEnergy) as totalEnergyToday, COUNT(DISTINCT DeviceID) as deviceCount FROM LatestData WHERE rn = 1 ), YesterdayData AS ( SELECT SUM(ElectricEnergy) as totalEnergyYesterday FROM ( SELECT DeviceID, Name, ElectricEnergy, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY DeviceID, Name ORDER BY UpdateTime DESC) as rn FROM RSWS_TempMonitor_Copy WHERE Workshop = '1#办公楼' AND ElectricEnergy IS NOT NULL AND UpdateTime >= DATEADD(DAY, -2, GETDATE()) AND UpdateTime < DATEADD(DAY, -1, GETDATE()) ) yd WHERE rn = 1 ) SELECT '1#办公楼' as workshop, COALESCE(td.totalEnergyToday, 0) as totalEnergyToday, COALESCE(yd.totalEnergyYesterday, 0) as totalEnergyYesterday, COALESCE(td.deviceCount, 0) as deviceCount, CASE WHEN yd.totalEnergyYesterday > 0 THEN ((td.totalEnergyToday - yd.totalEnergyYesterday) / yd.totalEnergyYesterday) * 100 ELSE 0 END as growthRate FROM TodayData td CROSS JOIN YesterdayData yd

WITH DailyTrend AS ( SELECT CAST(UpdateTime AS DATE) as day, SUM(ElectricEnergy) as totalEnergy FROM RSWS_TempMonitor_Copy WHERE Workshop = '1#办公楼' AND ElectricEnergy IS NOT NULL AND UpdateTime >= DATEADD(DAY, -7, GETDATE()) GROUP BY CAST(UpdateTime AS DATE) ) SELECT '1#办公楼' as workshop, day, totalEnergy, LAG(totalEnergy) OVER (ORDER BY day) as previousDayEnergy, CASE WHEN LAG(totalEnergy) OVER (ORDER BY day) > 0 THEN ((totalEnergy - LAG(totalEnergy) OVER (ORDER BY day)) / LAG(totalEnergy) OVER (ORDER BY day)) * 100 ELSE 0 END as changePercentage FROM DailyTrend ORDER BY day
